item.title: Iran targets Bahrain, slams 'fabricated' dirty-bomb report
item.description: Mediator Qatar urged "all parties" to show restraint following an uptick in hostilities, with Bahrain targeted three times in five days after a lull in Iranian attacks on Gulf countries since September Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Anti-Arab hate speech surged on social media during Israel’s election, report finds
item.description: Digital monitors recorded 400% rise in posts attacking Arab Israelis, including Netanyahu’s disproven fraud allegations Anti-Arab hate speech surged on social media in Israel around the country’s general election last month, digital monitors have said, as politicians including Benjamin Netanyahu levelled disproven allegations against Arab Israeli parties of election fraud. A new report by the Israel-based Brandeis Institute and FakeReporter recorded a deluge of anti-Arab discourse across social media platforms such as X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok in the days surrounding Israel’s 27… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: William Christou

item.title: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
item.description: Tehran rejects any suggestion it was plotting a so-called dirty bomb attack on the US capital as "baseless". Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: North Macedonia, Greece foil Iranian-linked plot to assassinate Israeli executive
item.description: Five suspects with alleged links to Iranian-linked drug lord Naji Sharifi Zindashti were arrested, while a sixth remains at large, North Macedonian authorities said. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Russian military transport aircraft crashes, killing all 17 on board
item.description: Local Governor Ilya Seredyuk reported a plane crash near the village of Yagunovo on his official channel on the MAX messaging platform, but did not identify the aircraft involved. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Saudi Arabia: Rights groups raise alarm over rising number of executions
item.description: Amid the war in Iran, Saudi Arabia's human rights situation remains bleak, with at least 211 executions, corporal punishment and an intensifying crackdown on critics. Is the regional conflict driving domestic repression? Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: EU sanctions Gaza Now social media outlet, group's founder for financially supporting Hamas
item.description: The FBI also outlined other ties between Gaza Now and Hamas, such as that Gaza Now had advance access to Hamas material, communicated directly with a Hamas email address, and collaborated on events. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Trump warns Iran over allegations of dirty bomb threat to Washington
item.description: Iran denied media reports based on US intelligence that it may be planning a dirty bomb attack in the US capital, with questions swirling about its actual intentions or real capabilities for such an act, but Trump issued a strong warning against Tehran "because they happen to be crazy." Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Trump claims US is ‘looking into’ Iranian bomb plot in Washington despite ‘no credible threats’
item.description: US officials ‘debate whether Iran can or will attempt to execute’ plot to detonate a ‘dirty bomb’, report says Donald Trump has claimed the US is “looking into” whether Iran is developing plans to detonate a so-called “dirty bomb” in Washington, even as the White House said there were “no credible threats” at this time. Trump said his administration takes the idea “very seriously” Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Leingang

item.title: Trump says he takes possible Iran bomb threat to Washington 'very seriously'
item.description: President Donald Trump said Tuesday that US authorities take any possible threats to Washington ‘very seriously’, following reports that Iran was planning to target senior Trump administration officials, possibly with a radioactive bomb. Tehran dismissed the reports as ‘fabricated’. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: France's Le Pen promises to lower retirement age, improve pensions if elected
item.description: A worker who starts their career in 2028 could on average expect a payout at retirement of €70,000 from the proposed fund, RN President Jordan Bardella said. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.description: "Our goal is to promote entrepreneurial freedom, non-ideological economic policies and business-friendly conditions," wrote Siegmund, with a link to a story about Tesla's expansion plans in Germany. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Iran dismisses report of alleged 'dirty bomb' attack on Washington
item.description: Iran has said CNN's claim that Tehran would attack Washington with a "dirty bomb" was an attempt to manufacture further legitimacy to continue the war. Trump has said his administration takes the claim "very seriously." Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: Netanyahu is pushing for new Iran attack in bid to stay in power, his rivals warn
item.description: Before the Israeli election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu agitated for fresh strikes on Iran, four people with knowledge of the matter said. Opposition leaders remain alarmed. Fuente: The Washington Post - World.

item.title: APEC summit: What Trump, Xi and Putin want
item.description: Trump, Xi and Putin will hold their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC. With different priorities on trade, Ukraine, Iran and arms control, what does each leader hope to gain? Fuente: Deutsche Welle - World.

item.title: 'Death is near': Inside the hoax bomb threats that rattled Europe's schools and airports
item.description: More than 8,000 bomb hoaxes have targeted schools, airlines and media outlets across Europe, disrupting flights and classes as officials investigate possible foreign interference. Fuente: The Jerusalem Post - International.

item.title: Russia says it would not accept Ukraine joining NATO

item.description: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: Qatar warns Gulf escalation poses 'grave danger' and announces new talks with Iran
item.description: Qatar warns the US and Iran to "avoid any escalation" as Iran's new attacks in Bahrain and its strikes on Gulf shipping are putting diplomacy under pressure. Qatar's foreign ministry announces new talks with Tehran, aiming to bridge the divide between US and Iran. Fuente: Euronews.

item.title: Iranians fear more civilian infrastructure could be targeted in new US war
item.description: Energy facilities, industrial units, ports and bridges, schools, hospitals and apartment buildings have already been hit Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: El Reino Unido eleva la presión sobre Israel y sanciona a ocho empresas por su papel en los asentamientos de Cisjordania
item.description: El Gobierno británico ha impuesto este martes sanciones a ocho empresas israelíes que han contribuido a la expansión de los asentamientos en la Cisjordania ocupada y a Tzav 9, un grupo activista israelí al que acusa de organizar bloqueos para impedir la entrada de ayuda humanitaria en Gaza. Las medidas incluyen la congelación de activos y la inhabilitación para ejercer cargos de dirección empresarial. Con estas medidas, Londres busca dificultar la financiación de nuevas construcciones en los asentamientos y actuar contra quienes obstaculizan el paso de los convoyes humanitarios hacia la… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
